name: Northwatch Expedition Base Camp
summary: Perched high on the ridges overlooking Greatwood Vale and Grimtotem Post, the Northwatch Expedition Base Camp is a fortified Alliance redoubt in the Stonetalon Mountains. Commanded by Force Commander Valen, it secures critical human military operations and shelters dwarven excavators probing the ancient earth below.

sections.title: A Foothold on the Ridge
sections.body: Tucked away in the mountains above Greatwood Vale, the Northwatch Expedition Base Camp serves as the forward staging ground for Theramore-aligned forces in Stonetalon. Under the firm command of Force Commander Valen, Northwatch Infantry hold the heights against Horde scouts and local threats, while an open stone pavilion serves weary soldiers and travelers as a rudimentary inn. From this vantage point, the Alliance surveys the volatile valleys below, keeping a watchful eye on both Horde movements and nearby Grimtotem encampments.

sections.title: The Dig Below
sections.body: The camp exists not merely as a military outpost, but to protect and sustain the Alliance's nearby mining and archeological operations. Troops stationed here defend the passages leading to the Unearthed Grounds and the cavernous shafts of the Deep Reaches. Dwarven scholars from the Explorers' League rely entirely on the camp's garrison to shield their deep digging from hostile counterattacks, turning the surrounding slopes into an active theater of border warfare.

faq.q: Who is in charge of this camp?
faq.answer: The outpost is headed by Force Commander Valen, who coordinates the garrison's infantry and oversees the protection of the surrounding excavation sites.

faq.q: Why are Northwatch troops all the way up in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: Northwatch forces have pushed inland from the coast to establish strategic Alliance footholds in Kalimdor. Here, their primary mission is protecting the Explorers' League digs in the Unearthed Grounds and maintaining pressure on Horde operations across Stonetalon.

faq.q: What are the Alliance digging for nearby?
faq.answer: Alliance miners and scholars from the Explorers' League are excavating the Deep Reaches and the Unearthed Grounds, searching for mineral riches and ancient relics buried beneath the Stonetalon crags.
Yes, although it consists of an open stone gazebo rather than a proper building. Travelers can rest their boots and bind their hearthstones with the garrison's innkeeper.

angles.text: This camp represents one of the few safe havens for Alliance forces deep in central Kalimdor, providing vital support for operations against regional Horde incursions.
The camp acts as a hostile staging ground right in Stonetalon, fueling the unwanted Alliance expansion into the Deep Reaches and threatening nearby outposts.
